name: The Emerald Tablet
effect: Once each turn, when one of your characters gains Memory or starts movement adjacent to a placed object, choose one allied character within 2 tiles of a placed object. It gains Shield or +1 RANGE on its next AP ability this turn.
real_relic_basis: Based on the Emerald Tablet tradition associated with Hermes Trismegistus, Hermeticism, alchemy, and the occult principle often summarized as above and below reflecting one another.
role: A green stone tablet the Flood Survivors saved from Atlantis and carried through underground routes toward Egypt. Later traditions call it Hermetic, but the Archivist suspects it is older than Hermes.
mechanical_lane: Rare wisdom relic that converts Memory and placed-stone positioning into flexible protection or range.
review_notes: Rare relic for the Flood Survivor sub-area.
This should feel like a true-myth/esoteric bridge between Atlantis, Egypt, alchemy, and later occult history.
Effect avoids direct shared relic/event deck viewing or manipulation.

name: The Black Sarcophagus
effect: Your Warrior and Hero each gain +1 maximum HP. Once each round, when an enemy adjacent to one of your placed objects attacks, Mark that enemy after the attack resolves.
role: Naia's central mystery: a sealed black-stone coffin that may be tomb, prison, archive, or body container. The voice inside knows her childhood name.
mechanical_lane: Defensive tomb relic and attacker-marking around placed objects.
review_notes: User direction: keep The Black Sarcophagus primarily as a relic, not an event.
May be strong with heavy placed-object builds; tune once Stone markers are finalized.

name: Tide-Sealed Archive
effect: Your Leader and Specialist each gain +1 RANGE on AP abilities. Once each turn, when an ally gains Memory, you may move that ally 1 tile. It must end on an empty tile.
role: Meret-Anu's sealed casket of witness fragments, bloodline proofs, drowned records, and edited truths.
mechanical_lane: Leader/Specialist range bonus and Memory-linked repositioning.
review_notes: The casket appears in Meret-Anu's character art and can become its own relic art later.
Represents memory as governed power rather than free revelation.

name: Seraphic Burial Veil
effect: Your Mystic gains +1 maximum HP. Once each round, when an ally would become Marked, you may prevent that Marked condition and give that ally Shield instead.
role: A funerary veil used in the water-burial rite that changed Thalassa-Nekh. It is unclear whether it invited the Drowned Seraph or merely survived its arrival.
mechanical_lane: Mystic durability and limited conversion of exposure into protection.
review_notes: Should feel protective and unsettling, not purely holy.
Good candidate for art with translucent burial cloth, black water, and faint nonhuman presence.

name: Basalt Ley Compass
effect: Your Common and Specialist each gain +1 MOVE. Once each turn, one of them may move through 1 allied placed object, but must end on an empty tile.
role: A stone-and-metal surveying instrument used by Menka and Iset-Nara to locate living routes under floodwater, desert, and tomb foundations.
mechanical_lane: Movement stat relic and practical route-breaking through stone objects.
review_notes: Can be tuned to once per round if repeated object traversal is too strong.

name: Pearl Of The Lower Vault
effect: Your Hero and Mystic each gain +1 RANGE on AP abilities. Once each round, when one of them prevents damage with Memory or Shield, Mark the attacker.
role: A luminous pearl recovered from a sealed pressure chamber beneath the drowned city. It contains a memory that cannot be spoken without making listeners weep.
mechanical_lane: Hero/Mystic range bonus and grief-as-judgment retaliation.
review_notes: Pairs naturally with Memory marker prevention and the Drowned Seraph event.
